text_block_list.text:
Passing by the central plaza, I spotted Kitasan Black
surrounded by her friends.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You got top marks on the practical singing exam?
Congrats~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
That vocal flourish made me cry too!
That's our Kita-chan for ya!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Is this not quite the reaction I expected?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, normally you'd be pumped enough
to burst out singing, 'It's a festival~!'

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm, you might be right.
I wonder why?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's supposed to be a joyous occasion...
Even though everyone is congratulating me...

It seems exhaustion is taking its toll on her.
I may need to rethink her upcoming schedule...
